description:
One substance with everything its own roster says (same as HTTP GET /v1/substances/{id}): identifiers, category, aliases, translations, the source-ledger row, groups, and — depending on the axis — Japanese use standards, EU/Codex conditions of use, mandatory labelling statements, the roster's definition text or the CFR citation.
Facts from the substance's own axis only; nothing here crosses an axis (that is get_substance_diff, paid, HTTP only). Axis-specific keys are present only where the roster has that concept, and an empty list means something (use_standards: [] = no use standard; use_conditions: [] = no permitted food category).
Not a safety judgement: every record is a draft and needs verification.

id.description: Substance id as returned by search_substances or analyze_label, e.g. eu:e951, jp:designated-aspartame, us:cfr-172-804.

name: get_substance
title: One substance, with everything its own roster says
